{{Quote|The Jedi must pay better than I thought.|Theron Shan|<ref name="The Old Republic: Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Prosperity''''' was a luxurious [[TZ-6 executive shuttle]] used by [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Theron Shan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] on their [[Mission to Ziost|mission]] to [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. It was also used as a part of a temporary deal that [[Teff'ith]] set up to get an [[Imperial shuttle]] to fly to [[Reaver Station]] in order to take out The ''[[Ascendant Spear]]''.
